topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: The path we tread, together, feels longer now, the air holding a new chill. Every step, each rustle in the leaves, seems to echo a change. My paws press deeper into the earth, as if trying to anchor us both here, to this moment. The forest, once a tapestry of shared moments, now stretches wide with an unknown distance. I notice the way the light filters through the canopy has shifted, as if the sun itself is retreating. I keep close, my gaze not leaving the familiar outline, the warmth that soon will be miles away. I hope the scent of home stays with you, as it will linger here, a silent promise of return.
